title: Pre-flip hardening of the W-1 verify gate: re-run rule, header wording, pinned step list, test gaps (follow-up of WCLI-120)
description: Non-blocking findings from the Opus review of ward-cli#228 (squash 7d8484c1c012fb957aea42469dcae8feb1b7a86c, unit ward-cli-review-228, claude-opus-5-5, APPROVE at 766471f), condensed by team-lead, so this is a relay. This task BLOCKS THE PUBLIC FLIP (ODOC-552 flip gate). Do not start it until it is admitted in a day plan. Findings: (1) a re-run after the flip reuses the pre-flip payload (private: true) and so skips the hosted check; add a runbook rule: after the flip cut a new tag, never re-run a run from before the flip. (2) release.yml header lines 14-16 still say unconditionally that an unverified signature cannot publish; make it conditional, as the job comment already is. (3) NB1 carried from 96b: stepIfs() only collects guards that mention private, so an unguarded step inserted before verify (for example codesign --force -s -) passes every test; pin verify step list. (4) test the missing-repository-object case: the JS evaluator throws where GitHub yields null. (5) the #228 body residual is slightly broad: numeric 1 and "1" also compare equal to true and skip; correct the wording. (6) the WCLI-96 note says "this host": name minim4 and say it supersedes the earlier note "reject-path dry run owed ... wait on dec-14tajwo" (the WCLI-96 correction is recorded in this change as a new note, not a rewrite). Also carried from 96b: NB4-NB7 recorded on WCLI-96 remain open there.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A runbook rule says to cut a new tag after the public flip and never re-run a run from before the flip
The release.yml header states the unverified-signature gate conditionally, matching the job comment
A test fails if any step other than the pinned download and codesign steps is added to the verify job, or the missing-repository case is untested
The WCLI-96 record names minim4 and states that the reject-path proof supersedes the dry-run-owed note
